Requirement: List products with their category and price
Acceptance Criteria: "Each product appears with its category and price; products without a category remain visible with a blank category."

Requirement: Find the most expensive products in each category
Acceptance Criteria: "Return the product or products with the highest price for each category"

Requirement: Identify products within a particular price range
Acceptance Criteria: "For supplied minimum and maximum prices and return products whose prices are within the inclusive range; reject a minimum greater than the maximum."
"Return all products ordered by price from lowest to highest; use product name ascending to make equal-price ordering deterministic."
"Return all products ordered by category ascending and then product name ascending; products without a category appear last."

Requirement: Find customers who have placed the most orders
Acceptance Criteria: "Count orders per customer and return every customer tied for the highest count; show each customer's name and order count."
"Return one row per customer with total spending calculated as the sum of their order-line sales amounts; customers with no orders have a total of zero."

Requirement: Identify customers who have not placed orders
Acceptance Criteria: "Return every customer with no associated order; do not omit customers because their order data is absent."
"Rank all customers by total spending from highest to lowest; customers with equal spending share a rank and each row shows the customer and total."
"For each customer and product category calculate total order-line sales amount and rank categories within that customer from highest to lowest; equal totals share a rank."
"Aggregate sales amount by calendar month using the order date; each month shows its revenue total and months with no sales show zero."
"Return up to 10 products ordered by total units sold from highest to lowest; break ties by product name ascending and show units sold."
"Show total sales amount grouped by calendar year using the order date with years ordered chronologically and the same sales-amount calculation used for every year."
"Show total sales amount grouped by calendar month across years; identify each period by year and month and order periods chronologically."

Requirement: Calculate each product's percentage contribution to revenue
Acceptance Criteria: "For each product show its sales amount as a percentage of total sales amount for the same reporting period; percentages use a consistent denominator and sum to 100% before display rounding."

Requirement: Rank the top best-selling products in each category
Acceptance Criteria: "Within each category rank products by total units sold from highest to lowest; equal unit totals share a rank and each result shows category.product.rank and units sold."
"Return products whose on-hand quantity is below the applicable low-stock or reorder threshold; show product/location/quantity on hand and threshold."
"Show on-hand quantity for each product at each location including locations with zero stock so quantities can be compared consistently."
"Show each product's count of completed sales transactions in the selected period ordered from most frequent to least frequent; break ties by product name ascending."

Requirement: Create a report to help prioritize restocking
Acceptance Criteria: "List products below their reorder threshold with current quantity. threshold. and shortfall; order by greatest shortfall first then by highest sales frequency."
